metadata.description: Skills for writing rules, skills and hooks for Claude, and a method to keep each rule backed by a logged case.

plugins.name: write-prompt
plugins.description: Writes prompts another model reads - CLAUDE.md rules, skills, commands, hook messages, subagent and API prompts - covering only what Claude skips on its own.

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: Keeps work not done yet as short handoffs a fresh session can start from: one section per task in the repo's BACKLOG.md, or issues in the tracker you name.
